name: MAGARAC
description: Magarac (literally 'Donkey') is a high-speed, lighthearted card-passing game popular in Croatia, Serbia, and the wider Balkan region. Similar to the Western game 'Spoons' or 'Pig', it is a game of reaction and physical speed. Players pass cards around the table attempting to collect four of a kind, after which a frantic 'slam' follows to avoid being the last person noticed.

content.text: Magarac (literally 'Donkey') is a high-speed, lighthearted card-passing game popular in Croatia, Serbia, and the wider Balkan region. Similar to the Western game 'Spoons' or 'Pig', it is a game of reaction and physical speed. Players pass cards around the table attempting to collect four of a kind, after which a frantic 'slam' follows to avoid being the last person noticed.
A regional Balkan evolution of the 19th-century matching games. It shares roots with the English 'Pig' and the German 'Schweinerei'.
Use 4 cards of the same rank for each player. (e.g., 4 players = 16 cards total).
Standard deck, tokens for spelling MAGARAC.
Each player is dealt 4 cards face-down.

items.text: Spoons: The US variant using spoons in the center.
Pig: The silent variant where players touch their nose.
Magarac with 'Traveling Joker': Adds an extra card that blocks victory.
